notes:
Diastema 0.32.0-beta.3 (beta)

This beta is everything Diastema has, in one build: the stable version (through 0.29.10) and every beta since. An office that switches from stable to beta gets it. With Open Dental, the office works the way it does today.

Changed since 0.32.0-beta.2

- Text a visit's forms: the Send window on a visit (the Forms card's This visit, and the consent badge on the schedule) now has Text beside Email and Copy link, while the office has Texting and the person may read and send texts. The visit's consents and before-visit page go on the patient's link, and Diastema texts it to their mobile.
- See and change a text before it goes: Text in Send forms, Send forms → Consent and a visit's Send now shows the text first, filled in for the patient, with who it goes to. Change the words for this patient if needed, then Send text (or Cancel). {link} marks where the patient's forms link goes and has to stay in the text. The office's own wording is still in Settings → Texting → Templates.
- Patient page: the Forms card is at the top, with Treatment plans under it, then Treatment follow-up. The jump bar under the name follows the same order.
- Patient page: Unscheduled treatment starts folded, showing its count and total. Click it to open the list.

Before you switch

Coming from 0.32.0-beta.1 or beta.2: nothing to do; there is no database update in this beta.

Coming from stable: see the 0.32.0-beta.2 notes. A database update runs once at the first start and saves a copy of the database first (in the data folder's backups, named "before-v49"). Keep that copy.
